# freshdesk_forum_category (Resource)

A community forum category, the top level of the discussions tree.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the category.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the category.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the category was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the category.
- `updated_at` (String) When the category was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_forum_category.example 42
```
